title: DocayaEventEnvelope
description: Common envelope for every Docaya domain event. Technical Architecture Document v1.3, Section 24.3 and 24.4. Events are written through a transactional outbox: the state change and its event commit in a single SQL transaction and are dispatched afterwards, so an event can never describe a state that did not persist.

eventId.description: Unique identifier of this event instance.

eventType.description: Fully qualified event name from the catalogue.

eventVersion.description: Schema version of the data payload. Additive change only within a version.

occurredAtUtc.description: When the state change committed, not when the message was dispatched.

correlationId.description: W3C trace correlation identifier, carried from the originating request into the audit record.

causationId.description: Identifier of the event or command that caused this event.

idempotencyKey.description: Delivery is at-least-once and consumers are idempotent. A redelivered message produces one result, never a duplicate.

sessionId.description: Set to the document identifier where ordering matters, so stage transitions for one document are processed in order (TAD 24.4).

actor.description: Principal that caused the change. Never contains document content or personal data beyond the identifier.

data.description: Event-specific payload, validated against the matching event schema.
